## Task

```{r SetUp, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}

library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


# Load configuration and functions
source(here::here("config.R"))
source(here::here("R/plot_density_grid.R"))
```

### Load Data

```{r}
# ----Data-Load-----

# Load resampled raster datasets (AI, TWI, fused)
mi_5km_r <- terra::rast(mi_5km_file) * 0.0001 # Multiply all values by 0.0001 to get original value
fused_5km_r <- terra::rast(fused_5km_file)
cor_twi_vegh_5km_r <- terra::rast(cor_twi_vegh_mosaic_file)

# Stack rasters into a single SpatRaster
stacked <- c(cor_twi_vegh_5km_r,
             fused_5km_r,
             mi_5km_r)

# Convert to data frame for k-means clustering
df <- as.data.frame(stacked, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(df) <- c("lon", "lat", "cor", "fused", "mi")

rm(mi_5km_r, fused_5km_r, cor_twi_vegh_5km_r, stacked); gc()
```

### Binning Variables

### 5 MI-bin

```{r bin5}

tictoc::tic()

# --- Compute MI quantile breaks (5 bins) ---
mi_breaks <- quantile(df$mi, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/5), na.rm = TRUE)

# Custom prefix labels for each MI bin
mi_prefix <- c("arid","semi-arid",
               "mod",
               "sub-humid","humid")

# Generate multi-line factor levels for MI
mi_levels <- paste0(mi_prefix, "\n", levels(cut(df$mi, breaks = mi_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)))

# --- Fused variable breaks and labels ---
fused_breaks <- c(0, 0.05, 0.4, 1)
fused_prefix <- c("no_land_use","low_land_use","high_land_use")
fused_levels <- paste0(fused_prefix, "\n", levels(cut(df$fused, breaks = fused_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)))

# --- Bin variables and generate multi-line labels ---
df_binned5 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Cut numeric variables into bins
    mi_bin = cut(mi, breaks = mi_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE),
    fused_bin = cut(fused, breaks = fused_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE),
    
    # Combine prefix and bin range for plotting labels
    mi_label_range = paste0(mi_prefix[as.numeric(mi_bin)], "\n", as.character(mi_bin)),
    fused_label_range = paste0(fused_prefix[as.numeric(fused_bin)], "\n", as.character(fused_bin))
  ) %>%
  # Convert to factors with explicit levels for plotting order
  mutate(
    mi_label_range = factor(mi_label_range, levels = mi_levels),
    fused_label_range = factor(fused_label_range, levels = fused_levels),
    
    # Create interaction strata for grouped analysis
    strata = interaction(mi_bin, fused_bin, drop = TRUE)
  )


tictoc::toc()
```

```{r checkds5}
# check data
table(df_binned5$mi_bin)
table(df_binned5$fused_bin)
table(df_binned5$strata_label)
```

```{r plot5bin}

df_binned5 |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mi_label_range, y = cor, fill = fused_label_range)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), size = 0.3, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "MI category",
    y = expression(r[H~TWI]),
    fill = "Land use intensity",
    title = "Boxplots of correlation across MI and Land Use bins"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1)
  )
```


### 9 MI-bin

```{r bin9}

tictoc::tic()

# --- Compute MI quantile breaks (9 bins) ---
mi_breaks <- quantile(df$mi, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/9), na.rm = TRUE)

# Custom prefix labels for each MI bin
mi_prefix <- c("arid+++","arid++","arid+",
               "mod—","mod","mod+",
               "humid+","humid++","humid+++")

# Generate multi-line factor levels for MI
mi_levels <- paste0(mi_prefix, "\n", levels(cut(df$mi, breaks = mi_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)))

# --- Fused variable breaks and labels ---
fused_breaks <- c(0, 0.05, 0.4, 1)
fused_prefix <- c("no_land_use","low_land_use","high_land_use")
fused_levels <- paste0(fused_prefix, "\n", levels(cut(df$fused, breaks = fused_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)))

# --- Bin variables and generate multi-line labels ---
df_binned9 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Cut numeric variables into bins
    mi_bin = cut(mi, breaks = mi_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE),
    fused_bin = cut(fused, breaks = fused_breaks, include.lowest = TRUE),
    
    # Combine prefix and bin range for plotting labels
    mi_label_range = paste0(mi_prefix[as.numeric(mi_bin)], "\n", as.character(mi_bin)),
    fused_label_range = paste0(fused_prefix[as.numeric(fused_bin)], "\n", as.character(fused_bin))
  ) %>%
  # Convert to factors with explicit levels for plotting order
  mutate(
    mi_label_range = factor(mi_label_range, levels = mi_levels),
    fused_label_range = factor(fused_label_range, levels = fused_levels),
    
    # Create interaction strata for grouped analysis
    strata = interaction(mi_bin, fused_bin, drop = TRUE)
  )

tictoc::toc()
```

```{r checkds9}
# check data
table(df_binned9$fused_bin)
table(df_binned9$fused_bin)
table(df_binned9$strata_label)
```

```{r plot}

df_binned9 |>

    x = "MI category",
```
